ostrzezenia.tekst: A boiling-water bath is suitable only for acid foods, such as fruits, pickles, jams and fruit butters, and only with the research-based process times of the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning. [T:SZY-054]
Do not change the proportions of vinegar, vegetables and water and do not use vinegar of unknown acidity; use only recipes with tested proportions. [T:ACI-016]
Use only vinegar labelled 5% acidity; white and cider vinegar can be used interchangeably; do not use wine vinegars, homemade vinegar or lemon juice. [T:ACI-509]

akapity: Eggplant and summer squash, such as zucchini and pattypan squash, are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6. [T:ACI-026]
Using a boiling-water bath for low-acid foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning. [T:SZY-054]
Without a tested recipe, there is no checked process time or vinegar proportion for eggplant in vinegar. [T:-]
